en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a grand hotel building atop a wooded hill, labeled as the 'Hotel Imperial'. In the foreground, there is a statue on a plinth surrounded by a small garden or park area, referred to as the 'Denkmal Kaiser Franz Josef I.' (Monument of Emperor Franz Joseph I). The image is framed by trees and paths, with a mountainous background. The style and typeface of the text suggest early 20th-century design.
